data.name: Into The Garden
data.detailed_description:
Step Into The Garden

You awaken as a stitched, button eyed cat doll in a eerie manor that's trapped in a supernatural limbo  where raindrops fall upward and clocks tick backward. Hunted by a towering, seamingly soulless marionette, you must navigate a decaying world that's trying everything to keep you trapped.

Core Gameplay

  • Seamless Mirror Portals: Gaze through standing mirrors to view adjacent rooms in real time. Step through the glass to bend perspective and solve different puzzles.

  • Painted Pocket Worlds: Enter framed canvases to explore distorted memories that seem to be trapped in time.

  • Sound Based Stealth: The Toymaker wanders the corridors. His eyes are violently sewn shut, making him completely blind, but his hearing is incredibly sharp. Move silently, as clumsy actions, load noise and heavy footsteps will draw his strings directly to you.

  • Transfer Your Soul: You are not bound to a single fabric toy. Swap your life force into another abandoned toy to gain unique abilities. Leave the nimble cat behind and possess a heavy bear to shatter cracked floors or push massive obstacles. Watch the button eyes of the empty shells fade to a lifeless gray when you leave them behind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel(R) Celeron(R) N4020 CPU @ 1.10GHz 1.10 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 5870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
